title: GUI Enhancements
outcome_summary: All six GUI enhancements were implemented as specified. The changes are scoped exclusively to the GUI frontend files and one backend API handler, following existing patterns throughout. No new dependencies, files, or architectural patterns were introduced.
project_summary: This project implements six targeted GUI enhancements for the MCP server dashboard: sortable repository columns, store modal field reordering with path guidance notes, config tab reordering, a server-side repository filter on the project list, breadcrumb links that pre-select the repository filter, and a fix for the assigned_to field not updating during live polling. All changes follow existing GUI patterns and are scoped to frontend files plus one backend API handler, with no new dependencies or architectural changes introduced.
